description:
## What
Add a private helper `cert_subject_alt_names(cert) -> Option<&SubjectAltName>` in pkix-path/src/lib.rs that extracts the SAN extension from a certificate's extensions list.

## Algorithm
- Iterate `cert.tbs_certificate.extensions` (if Some)
- Match on `OID_SUBJECT_ALT_NAME` (2.5.29.17)
- Decode the extension value as `SubjectAltName` and return it
- Return None if extension absent or on parse error (treat missing SAN as empty set)
- Also add OID_SUBJECT_ALT_NAME constant

## Acceptance criteria
- Returns Some(&san) for a cert that has SAN
- Returns None for a cert without SAN extension
- Does not panic on malformed extension value (returns None)
title: Add cert_subject_alt_names() extractor helper
